_comment: Outstanding things only someone at the property can settle. Fetched at load by viewer.html (NOT inlined — no _DATA const, so check-data-inline.py does not track it; a failed fetch just means an absent queue, which is the correct calm behavior). Paul authors a row, commits, pushes; on pickup he acts on the answer (edit plants.json, flip confidence inferred->verified) and sets the row active:false (or deletes it). Mom's answers land via POST /api/feedback with context.{type:'mom-queue',questionId,kind}; Paul reads them with tools/read-mom-feedback.py. Schema is forward-compatible: kind = confirm|react|open, answerMode = yesno|sentiment|text. v1 probe (2026-07-13) seeds confirm items only.

questions.prompt: The crocosmia that came into bloom this month — we read it off a photo as the variety **'Lucifer,'** but that's a guess from the picture. Does that match the one flowering out there?
The big white mophead hydrangea — from the photo it looks like **'Annabelle,'** the old smooth-hydrangea standby. Right on the ground, or something else?

entityRef.note: the white mophead in the hydrangea roster

questions.prompt: Anything else on your mind — a plant we're missing, a date that's off, something about the app? Set it down here and Paul will see it.
questions._note: The standing general-feedback channel — deliberately one quiet foot-line, not a co-equal item. Repeatable (never dismissed). Its note-only answers need the /api/feedback relax deployed (tools/deploy-worker.sh) to reach the server; until then the localStorage backup holds them. Set active:false to remove the line entirely.
